title: Narrow scope keep the core
body: Ambition outran v1 (Rails → refiltering) — narrowed version worked and kept the whole idea.

title: Bounded resumable jobs
body: Scale stopped unbounded ingest — checkpointed jobs beat heroic must-finish runs.

title: Write continuity where work lives
body: Four architectures and renamed projects — this audit exists because rebuilds happened.

title: Protect before optimize
body: Irreplaceable corpus had zero copies — coverage beats cleverness.

title: Small verified wins
body: Ship measurable progress; working threshold beats perfect design.

title: Document the real day
body: Honest day logs and voice-on-walk constraints become methods not shame.

title: Progress as unlocks
body: Present work as accumulating unlocks (roguelike) not opaque grind — engagement design for learning.
